scope: Exact source/receipt archive and native boards. Frozen generic reporter wording is inherited; current conditional/neural modes are phase-kernel reconstruction above fixed global analytic/neural backgrounds. Raw H1 uses its own original scores. Prior/current share broad geometry/background/phase/support and exactly the same fine proposals; fine WLS full/null validates a sinusoidal full-fit carrier delivery with identical RAW/parent projection. Broad carriers remain in fine global nuisance; no fine phase/range/edge-side pooling. This is not an isolated harmonic-only ablation or strict spectral cutoff.

Lower NN error/correction in some contexts is an available measured tradeoff, with less weak response.

quality_decision.limitations: Cab purple/green periodic grid persists under H1 fine delivery; no faithful colour/mesh recovery. Analytic building maximum148.908 to154.781 DN16; neural59.693 to65.109. Correction magnitudes are not real-reference errors. Fine waveform restriction is insufficient to eliminate failure; this does not prove a unique cause. Two-source adaptive cohort, no generalization/confidence or broad-model promotion. V120 remains general baseline.
quality_decision.default_policy: Fine phase remains default; sinusoidal fine delivery explicit opt-in. Both earlier useful options and costs preserved.
